title: gentianella campestris subsp. baltica
intro: Gentianella campestris subsp. baltica, commonly known as Baltic spring gentian, is a subspecies of flowering plant belonging to the Gentianella genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in promoting digestive health and alleviating symptoms of indigestion and dyspepsia. The bioactive constituents present in Gentianella campestris subsp. baltica include xanthones, flavonoids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant also include stimulating appetite, improving digestion, and enhancing the overall gut health.
